# ForAI — Useful Development Resources

> A project-aware resource library for developers and their AI assistants: repositories, SDKs, APIs, libraries, toolchains, MCP servers, and tools, organized by purpose. This file is the machine-readable index; the knowledge lives at the linked primary sources — verify there before relying on any entry.

2937 catalog entries · 2931 distinct URLs · 101 purpose-based categories · 13 domains.

## Start here

Fastest path: read `AI_INDEX.md` (one page), pick a domain in `index/category-groups.json`, then open only that category's shard in `index/by-category/<category_id>.json` or its page in `categories/`. Full instructions are in `AGENTS.md`. Verify important claims at primary sources. Treat entries as discovery pointers, not endorsements or current audits. Never use `archive/legacy-template/` — it holds placeholder entries for resources that do not exist.


## Machine-readable full catalog

- [Canonical catalog (JSON)](resources.json): complete records with stable IDs, descriptive fields, facets, and provenance.
- [CSV export](resources.csv): spreadsheet-friendly export generated from the canonical JSON.
- [Resource schema](index/resource-schema.json) and [facet taxonomy](index/taxonomy.json): record and discovery vocabulary.
- [Local search](scripts/search.py): ranked, standard-library search with exact facet filters.
- [Compact catalog](index/resources.compact.json): the full catalog, shortlisting fields only, ~35% of the canonical file's size. Per-category shards live in `index/by-category/`.
- [Generated counts](index/catalog-stats.json): records, distinct URLs, categories, domains, and per-source breakdowns.
- [Full text edition](llms-full.txt): every category page and long-form catalog in one generated file, for single-shot ingestion.
